name.text: Digital Logic - Q2: Gray and Binary Conversions

questiontext.text:
Perform the following code conversions:

(a) Convert binary {@bin_val@} to Gray code:

Gray = [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Convert Gray code {@gray_val@} to binary:

Binary = [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

(a) Binary {@bin_val@} to Gray:

Rule: \( g_n = b_n \), \( g_i = b_{i+1} \oplus b_i \)

  • Bits: {@b[1]@} {@b[2]@} {@b[3]@} {@b[4]@} {@b[5]@} {@b[6]@} {@b[7]@} {@b[8]@}
  • Gray bits: {@g_res[1]@} {@g_res[2]@} {@g_res[3]@} {@g_res[4]@} {@g_res[5]@} {@g_res[6]@} {@g_res[7]@} {@g_res[8]@}

(b) Gray {@gray_val@} to Binary:

Rule: \( b_n = g_n \), \( b_i = b_{i+1} \oplus g_i \)

  • Gray bits: {@gray_bits[1]@} {@gray_bits[2]@} {@gray_bits[3]@} {@gray_bits[4]@} {@gray_bits[5]@} {@gray_bits[6]@} {@gray_bits[7]@} {@gray_bits[8]@}
  • Binary bits: {@b_res[1]@} {@b_res[2]@} {@b_res[3]@} {@b_res[4]@} {@b_res[5]@} {@b_res[6]@} {@b_res[7]@} {@b_res[8]@}

generalfeedback.text:
